Post Date: May 29, 2026

Join Indian Navy (Nausena Bharti), has released the Answer Key for the Indian Navy Civilian INCET 01/2025 Recruitment Posts. The Re-exam will be conducted on January-February 2026. and the last date to submit the application form was 18 July 2025. Candidates Can Also Check Answer Key using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below. (Advt. No. 01/2025)

Post Name Eligibility Criteria
Staff Nurse
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School Examination from any recognized Board in India.
  • Certificate of training in an approved Hospital as a Nurse.
  • Registered as a fully trained nurse in the Medical and Surgical Nursing and Midwifery.
  • Desirable : Knowledge of Hindi or local language
Chargeman (Naval Aviation)
  • Candidate should have held the rank of Petty Officer or equivalent and have seven years’ service/ experience as such in the appropriate technical branch of the Army/ Navy or Air Force. Or
  • Diploma in Aeronautical or Electrical or Mechanical or Tele-Communication or Automobile Engineering. Or
  • Matriculates with approved apprenticeship and 5 years’ experience in the trade.
Chargeman (Ammunition Workshop)
  • Bachelor of Science degree with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University or Institution. Or
  • A Diploma in Chemical Engineering from a recognized University or Board.
Chargeman (Mechanic)
  • Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical or Electronics or Production Engineering from a recognized University or Institute; and
  • Two years’ experience in quality control or quality assurance or testing or proof in the area of design or production or maintenance of engineering equipment or system from a recognized organization.
Chargeman (Ammunition and Explosive)
  • Diploma in Chemical Engineering from a recognized University or Institution with two years experience in Quality Control or Quality Assurance or Testing or Proof in the area of Chemical Engineering or Processing from a recognized organization.
Chargeman (Electrical)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Electrical Engineering recognized by University or Board.
Chargeman (Electronics and Gyro)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Electronics/ Electronics & Instrumentation/ Electronics & Communication/ Electronics & Telecommunication / Instrumentation/ Instrumentation & Control/ Communication Engineering recognized by University or Board.
Chargeman (Weapon Electronics)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Electronics/ Electronics & Instrumentation/ Electronics & Communication/ Electronics & Telecommunication / Instrumentation/ Instrumentation & Control/ Communication Engineering recognized by University or Board.
Chargeman (Instrument)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Electronics/ Electronics & Instrumentation/ Instrumentation/ Instrumentation & Control Engineering recognized by University or Board.
Chargeman (Mechanical)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering recognized by University or Board.
Chargeman (Heat Engine)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering recognized by University or Board.

  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering recognized by University or Board.

  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering recognized by University or Board.

  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or

Chargeman (Auxiliary)

  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or

Chargeman (Mechatronics)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or

Chargeman (Civil Works)

  • Diploma in Civil Engineering recognized by University or Board.
Chargeman (Machine)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering recognized by University or Board.
Chargeman (Planning, Production and Control)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University. Or
  • Diploma in Electrical/ Electronics/ Electronics & Instrumentation/ Electronics & Communication/ Electronics & Telecommunication/ Instrumentation/ Instrumentation & Control/ Communication/ Mechanical/ Mechanical/ Chemical Engineering/ Dress Making/ Garment Fabrication/ Paint Technology/ Automobile/ Refrigeration & Air Conditioning/ Mechatronics/ Civil Engineering recognized by University or Board.
Assistant Artist Retoucher
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School Examination from any recognized Board in India.
  • Diploma or Certificate in Commercial Art, Printing Technology, Lithography or Litho Art Work awarded after at least 2 years course or training from a recognized Institute. 
  • 02 years’ experience as a retoucher. Or
  • 07 years’ practical experience as a retoucher in Military Survey, Survey of India or other Photo-Litho establishment of repute (for ex-Servicemen only).
Pharmacist
  • Candidates who have passed their class 12th / Intermediate Examination with Science, Diploma in Pharmacy, 02 Years Experience.
  • Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized institute
  • Registered as Pharmacist under the Pharmacist Act, 1948 (8 of 1948)
  • Two years experience as Pharmacist in any recognized hospital or pharmacy after duly registered as Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948 (8 of 1948); and 
  • The candidate shall have working knowledge of computer
Cameraman
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School Examination from any recognized Board in India.
  • Diploma or certificate in Printing Technology awarded after at least two years course or training from a recognized Institute.
  • 5 years’ experience of operating process cameras. Or
  • 10 years experience as a Cameraman or photographer in Military Survey, Survey of India or other photo-litho establishment of repute (for ex-Servicemen only).
Store Superintendent (Armament)
  • Degree in Science with Physics or Chemistry or Mathematics from a recognized University with basic computer knowledge on database management with one year experience in stores work in Government Department or Public Sector Undertaking or in a reputed firm. Or
  • 10+2 in Science or Commerce with five years experience in stores’ work in a Government Department or Public Sector Undertaking or in a reputed workshop.
Fire Engine Driver
  • Candidates who have passed their class 12th Examination from any recognized Board in India + Heavy Motor Vehicle License.
  • Physical Standards.
  • Must be physically fit and capable of performing strenuous duties and must have passed the test specified below:-
    (i) Height without shoes- 165 centimeters provided that a concession 2.5 centimeters height shall be allowed for Scheduled Tribes.
    (ii) Chest (normal)- 81.5 centimeters.
    (iii) Chest (on expansion)- 85 centimeters.
    (iv) Weight- 50 kilograms (minimum).
    (v) Eye sight -6/6 without any correction (normal vision).
  • Endurance Test.
    (i) Carrying a person (fireman lift of 63.5 kilograms to a distance of 183 meters within 96 seconds);
    (ii) Clearing 2.7 meters wide ditch landing on both feet (long jump); and
    (iii) Climbing 3 meters vertical rope using hand and feet.
Fireman
  • Candidates who have passed their class 12th Examination from any recognized Board in India.
  • Elementary or basic or auxiliary Fire Fighting course from a recognized institute.
  • Possession of heavy motor vehicle license.
  • Physical Standards:- The candidate shall be physically fit and capable of performing strenuous duties and must pass the test specified below:-
    (i) Height without shoes- 165 centimeters provided that a
    concession 2.5 centimeters height shall be allowed for
    Scheduled Tribes.
    (ii) Chest (normal)- 81 centimeters.
    (iii) Chest (on expansion)- 85 centimeters.
    (iv) Weight- 50 kilograms (minimum).
    (v) Eye sight- 6/6 (normal Vision).
  • Endurance Test-
    (i) Carrying a person (fireman lift of 63.5 kilograms to a distance of 183 meters within 96 seconds);
    (ii) Clearing 2.7 meters wide ditch landing on both feet (long jump); and
    (iii) Climbing 3 meters vertical rope using hand and feet.
Storekeeper/ Storekeeper (Armament)
  • Candidates who have passed their class 12th / Intermediate Examination from any recognized Board in India with one-year experience in inventory related stores work in government department or Public undertaking or in a reputed firm.
Civilian Motor Driver Ordinary Grade
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School Examination from any recognized Board in India.
  • Must possess a driving license for Heavy Vehicles and Motor Cycles
  • One year practical experience in Heavy Motor Vehicles (HMVs) driving
Tradesman Mate
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School Examination from any recognized Board in India + ITI in Related Field.
Pest Control Worker
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School Examination from any recognized Board in India.
  • Must have knowledge of Hindi or regional language.
Bhandari
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School Examination from any recognized Board in India.
  • Knowledge of swimming
  • One year experience as Cook
Lady Health Visitor
  • Should be of Matriculation Standard and should have some special training after her basic Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery course unless she has done a course which has been specifically strengthen with regard to family planning and the total family planning health outlook.
Multi Tasking Staff (Mininsterial)
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School + ITI Examination from any recognized Board in India.
Multi Tasking Staff (Non Industrial)/ Ward Sahaika
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School + ITI Examination from any recognized Board in India.
Multi Tasking Staff (Non Industrial)/ Dresser
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School + ITI Examination from any recognized Board in India.
Multi Tasking Staff (Non Industrial)/ Dhobi
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School + ITI Examination from any recognized Board in India.
Multi Tasking Staff (Non Industrial)/ Mali
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School + ITI Examination from any recognized Board in India.
Multi Tasking Staff (Non Industrial)/ Barber
  • Candidates who have passed their class 10th / High School + ITI Examination from any recognized Board in India.
Draughtsman (Construction)
  • Certificate in Draughtsman ship (Mechanical or Civil) from Industrial Training Institute, recognized by National Council of Vocational Training or Ex-Naval apprentices trained in Mechanical or Civil Engineering.

 How To Check & Download Indian Navy Civilian INCET 01/2025 Answer Key 
  • Visit the official Indian Navy recruitment portal.
    (Look for the official careers / recruitment section where admit cards are released.)
  • On the homepage, find and click the section for Answer Key / Latest Notifications.
  • Look for the Indian Navy Civilian INCET 01/2025 Answer Key 2026 link.
  • Click on the link — you will typically be taken to a candidate login page.
  • Enter your login details as required, such as:
  • Registration Number / Application Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Or other credentials (if asked)
  • Submit the details to view your answer key on screen.
  • Download and save the answer key to your device.
